newsitem.title: USA: Zycon to merge with Hicks, Muse affiliate.
newsitem.headline: Zycon to merge with Hicks, Muse affiliate.

text.p: Zycon Corp said its board of directors approved a merger agreement with an affiliate of Hicks, Muse, Tate & Furst.
Under terms of the deal, the acquiring company, which was not named, will offer to buy all of the outstanding common shares of Zycon for $16.25 per share in cash.
Certain principal shareholders owning about 60% of the company's outstanding stock have agreed to tender all of their shares, Zycon said.

Zycon makes printed circuit boards for original equipment manufacturers and contract manufacturers in such industries as data communications, telecommunications, advanced storage systems, workstations, servers and personal computers.
